title: Linear solver exponent certificate
statement: Let a linear solver backend and a positive rational exponent $\omega$ be given. A certificate consists of a natural-number-valued coefficient function of three natural-number arguments, the bound $2 \leq \omega$, and the following work guarantee: for every finite encoded coordinate set, every list of linear equations over $\mathbb{F}_2$, and natural numbers $b,d,c_D,c_R$ with $0<b$, if the number of coordinates is at most $c_D b^d$ and the number of equations is at most $c_R b^d$, then the backend's work is at most $C(c_D,c_R,d)b^{\lceil \omega d\rceil}$, where $C$ is the certificate's coefficient function.
hypotheses_covered: The coordinate set is finite and encoded
The coordinate count is at most $c_D b^d$
The equation count is at most $c_R b^d$
